_comment: Home-plate-through-pitcher's-mound-to-center-field compass bearing (0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W) for MLB stadiums. Computed from real OpenStreetMap field geometry (mound centroid + outfield-wall polygon, cross-validated via two independent bisection methods agreeing within a few degrees) — not estimated or guessed. Parks omitted here have no reliable OSM field geometry to compute from (bare building footprint only, ambiguous geometry, or the source data itself is flagged as a position guess) and correctly fall back to a plain compass-direction table on the venue page instead of the field-relative diagram. See the research behind this: home plate and center-field coordinates plus per-park confidence notes are in the conversation history that produced this file.
